integrity: Self-contained proof and two independent exhaustive peeling implementations (orders 3 through 6), with an independent partition and connected-graph enumerator (orders 3 through 7). Numerical checks alone are not proofs of the all-order statements.
scientific_limitations: The all-order theorem presumes the complete pair-by-triple binary inclusion-check matrix, correct erasure observations, and synchronous peeling. General connectivity, cut-code and stopping-set bounds are acknowledged as classical. No independent mathematical priority audit has occurred.
title: Triangle-check peeling is graph powering, with exact stopping partitions
